html:
Unique Research · Insight / Capital Monthly · September 24, 2024 · Data window: August 2024 (YTD through Aug)

Ingest note: ~25 CN charts. EN keeps headline figures and board inventory from body text — attach or redraw tables on import; do not invent ranks absent from CN.

August 2024 snapshot

  • Global AIGC financing: ¥44.5B in August — +53.44% vs July.
  • Largest global raise: Groq $640M (~¥4.552B) at $2.8B post — BlackRock Private Equity Partners led; Cisco Investments, Samsung Catalyst Fund. Plan: move to 4nm next year for larger models / generality. LPU claimed ~10× Nvidia GPU inference speed at ~1/10 cost; cards ~$20k; Meta LLaMA adapted onto Groq silicon. From Apr: stop selling HW direct → GroqCloud for developers (>70k). Founder Jonathan Ross (ex-Google TPU core).
  • China: Moonshot (月之暗面) disclosed new $300M round — valuation past $3B among top China LLM startups (after Feb >¥1B). Founder Yang Zhilin (Tsinghua / CMU PhD / Tsinghua IIIS AP). 4 rounds: Sequoia China, ZhenFund, Meituan Longzhu, BlueRun, Alibaba, China Merchants, Xiaohongshu, Tencent, Gaorong — Alibaba A+ alone >$1B. Both Tencent and Alibaba have backed all four top China LLM names (rare vs mobile-internet era). ToC mode; Kimi MAU once >20M; enterprise API launched Aug 2.

1.1 Overseas August

Angels important: 11 early projects (Otto The Agent, Openmart.ai, Reliant AI, Cassidy, SportAI, Guardoc Health, VoiceLine, YGO Trips, Lumi Story AI, BrandRank.AI, Global Predictions) — ~¥290M estimated from individuals. 8 overseas LPs put >¥500M into AIGC; Google acquired Character.ai ~$2.5B. Second-largest deal: Recursion Pharmaceuticals (RXRX) all-stock ~$688M buy of Exscientia (EXAI).

1.2 China August

73 institutions; Fortune Capital (达晨) 4 deals. 39 AIGC firms funded; 11 over ¥100M incl. Moonshot, 01.AI (零一万物), Infinigence (无问芯穹).

1.3 YTD through August

  • Global: ¥256.5B; 617 events — amount +115% vs 2023 ¥118.9B; count +320% vs 145.
  • China: ~¥32.3B; 249 events — amount +186%, count +167% YoY.
  • China share: 14.4% of global amount; 67.66% of deal count.

02 Global trends & country mix

Q2 disclosed deals ~220 (~3.3× YoY). July deal count +~24% MoM. Amount spikes from mega LLM rounds: xAI $6B B (May); Anthropic $2.75B Amazon (Mar); Moonshot $1B Alibaba (Feb); Baichuan ¥2.824B (Jul). 2024 monthly mean amount ~¥32.0B. US ¥175.7B amount #1 / 211 deals (~85% of China’s count); China ¥32.3B #2 amount / 249 deals #1 count. Canada #3 amount after Cohere’s $500M (Jul). France #4 after Mistral + H (Holistic) ~¥5.83B in May.

03 China investors & hot projects (Jan–Aug)

Most active: MiraclePlus 17 (Shuzong, EdgeAI, GigaAI, animate.ai, ProDuck Lab, SiliconFlow, RWKV, etc.). Alibaba 7 (Baichuan, Moonshot, MiniMax, Wow Universe, Jingzhunxue, Yuanluo) — Unique Research estimates Alibaba book may exceed ¥11B by end-Aug. Shunxi Fund & Zhipu AI 5 each; Amoeba, Lingang Sci-Tech, Innoangel 4. 228 China AIGC firms raised; 51 over ¥100M. Top amounts: Moonshot $1.3B; MiniMax $600M; Zhipu $400M (Prosperity7, June). Monthly mean deals 31; Aug ~26% above average. Feb amount peak ¥8.2B (Moonshot $1B).

04 Overseas investors & hot projects

By count: a16z 10 (incl. xAI $6B). Lightspeed & Index 8; Index/Lux/Nvidia GPU Ventures 7. Angels 38 deals. By amount: Amazon ~¥20.3B; Google ~¥17.8B; a16z ¥7.6B. 26 overseas firms >¥1B YTD (vs 10 prior year). Overseas YTD ~¥224.2B (+89% YoY). Hot: xAI ¥42.65B; Anthropic ¥21.51B; Mistral ¥7.27B; also Cohere, Lambda, Skild AI, Tenstorrent, DeepL, Genmo >¥1B each. Overseas monthly path: Jan 42/¥6.969B → Feb 22/¥19.6B → Mar 14/¥32.3B → Apr 19/¥1.9B → May mega month ¥55.1B (xAI, Mistral, DeepL, Holistic…).

05 Secondary

AIGC concept index (East Money) Aug 30: 1091.34, MoM −4.08%; turnover ¥389.9B; turnover rate 48.1%. Top gainers cited: Fushi Holdings, iSoftStone, Dongyi Risheng, ST Kevin, Sanrenxing — company blurbs in CN charts.

[IMAGE PLACEHOLDERS — 25 CN charts. Attach from images.json.]

Disclaimer: Unique Research figures for market reference only; not investment advice.

— END —
